data.title: 波岛出海 · 黄昏坡道并肩推车的深情告白
data.description: 放学后红霞满天的长长樱花坡道上，并肩推着单车的出海突然停下脚步。少女双手揪着水手服开衫下摆，双马尾在晚风中轻晃，脸颊红透、用尽全身力气大喊“前辈是我一个人的”。
data.location: scenic sloping suburban street flanked by green hedges bathed in sunset
data.action: stopped on sunset slope beside bicycle, clutching cardigan hem, looking up at partner with burning crimson blush and heartfelt earnest eyes
data.lighting: brilliant golden hour sunset painting sky and asphalt in crimson gold
data.mood: heartfelt youth confession, passionate junior devotion, unforgettable sunset memory
data.promptProse: On a sunset suburban slope, Izumi Hashima clutches her cardigan hem, looking up at partner with a burning crimson blush and passionate brown eyes.
data.animaCaption: Izumi Hashima blushing heavily on sunset slope looking at partner.
